## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Relevant platform packaging was tested, or the untested platform is stated.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] No VM images, secrets, signing credentials, or build artifacts are included.

## Safety and scope

- [ ] Attacker VM lifecycle remains manually managed.
- [ ] Imported base disks remain protected by disposable overlays.
- [ ] Archive extraction safety checks are preserved.
